card.headline: Other ways to say "sorry"
card.sub: 15 better phrases with pictures and examples

beats.speech: Looking for other ways to say sorry in English? Here are fifteen better phrases: for a small mistake, for a real apology, and for work. Each one comes with a picture and an example. Let's start.

beats.label: a small mistake
beats.speech: Part 1. Five quick phrases for a small mistake.

card.headline: My bad
card.meaning: a very casual sorry for a small mistake

beats.speech: My bad. It is a very casual sorry for a small mistake. "Hey, that's my coffee." "Oh, my bad."

card.headline: Sorry about that
card.meaning: an everyday sorry for a small problem
card.example: "You sent me the wrong file." "Sorry about that."

beats.speech: Sorry about that. It is an everyday sorry for a small problem. "You sent me the wrong file." "Sorry about that."

card.headline: My mistake
card.example: "The meeting is at three, not two." "My mistake."

beats.speech: My mistake. It means sorry, I got it wrong. "The meeting is at three, not two." "My mistake."

card.headline: Excuse me
card.meaning: a polite sorry before you pass or interrupt

beats.speech: Excuse me. It is a polite sorry before you pass or interrupt. "Excuse me, can I get past?"

card.headline: Pardon me
card.meaning: a polite sorry when you bump into someone
card.example: "Pardon me, I didn't see you there."

beats.speech: Pardon me. It is a polite sorry when you bump into someone. "Pardon me, I didn't see you there."

card.headline: Which phrase fits?
card.question: "The meeting is at three, not two." "___."
card.answer: "The meeting is at three, not two." "My mistake."

beats.speech: Which phrase fits? The meeting is at three, not two. Blank. My mistake, or excuse me? | My mistake.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
Oh, my bad.
Sorry about that.
My mistake.
Excuse me, can I get past?
Pardon me, I didn't see you there.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | Oh, my bad. | Sorry about that. | My mistake. | Excuse me, can I get past? | Pardon me, I didn't see you there.

beats.label: a real apology
beats.speech: Part 2. Five stronger phrases for a real apology, when you have hurt someone.

card.headline: I am so sorry
card.example: "I am so sorry I forgot your birthday."

beats.speech: I am so sorry. It is a strong, sincere sorry. In conversation, people usually shorten it to I'm so sorry. "I am so sorry I forgot your birthday."

card.headline: That was my fault
card.meaning: I am the one to blame
card.example: "We missed the train. That was my fault."

beats.speech: That was my fault. It means I am the one to blame. "We missed the train. That was my fault."

card.headline: I owe you an apology
card.meaning: I know I was wrong, and I need to say sorry
card.example: "I owe you an apology for what I said yesterday."

beats.speech: I owe you an apology. It means I know I was wrong, and I need to say sorry. "I owe you an apology for what I said yesterday."

card.headline: Please forgive me
card.meaning: I am asking you not to be angry with me
card.example: "I broke my promise. Please forgive me."

beats.speech: Please forgive me. It means I am asking you not to be angry with me. "I broke my promise. Please forgive me."

card.headline: I feel terrible
card.meaning: I feel very bad about what I did
card.example: "I feel terrible about losing your book."

beats.speech: I feel terrible. It means I feel very bad about what I did. "I feel terrible about losing your book."

card.headline: Which phrase fits?
card.question: "___ for what I said yesterday."
card.options: I owe you an apology / My mistake
card.answer: "I owe you an apology for what I said yesterday."

beats.speech: Which phrase fits? Blank, for what I said yesterday. I owe you an apology, or my mistake? | I owe you an apology for what I said yesterday.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
I am so sorry I forgot your birthday.
That was my fault.
I owe you an apology.
Please forgive me.
I feel terrible about losing your book.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | I am so sorry I forgot your birthday. | That was my fault. | I owe you an apology. | Please forgive me. | I feel terrible about losing your book.

beats.label: at work
beats.speech: Part 3. Five professional phrases for work and for emails.

card.headline: I apologise
card.meaning: a formal way to say sorry
card.example: "I apologise for the mistake in the report."

beats.speech: I apologise. It is a formal way to say sorry. "I apologise for the mistake in the report."

card.headline: My apologies
card.example: "My apologies, I sent you the wrong date."

beats.speech: My apologies. It is a short, polite, formal sorry. "My apologies, I sent you the wrong date."

card.headline: Sorry for the delay
card.example: "Sorry for the delay. Here is the report."

beats.speech: Sorry for the delay. It means sorry that this is late. "Sorry for the delay. Here is the report."

card.headline: I take full responsibility
card.meaning: it was my mistake, and I accept that
card.example: "The order was late, and I take full responsibility."

beats.speech: I take full responsibility. It means it was my mistake, and I accept that. "The order was late, and I take full responsibility."

card.headline: Please accept my apologies
card.meaning: a very formal sorry, mostly used in writing
card.example: "Please accept my apologies for the late reply."

beats.speech: Please accept my apologies. It is a very formal sorry, mostly used in writing. "Please accept my apologies for the late reply."

card.headline: Which phrase fits?
card.question: An email to a customer: "___, I sent you the wrong date."
card.answer: An email to a customer: "My apologies, I sent you the wrong date."

beats.speech: Which phrase fits? An email to a customer. Blank, I sent you the wrong date. My apologies, or my bad? | My apologies, I sent you the wrong date.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
I apologise for the mistake in the report.
My apologies, I sent you the wrong date.
Sorry for the delay.
I take full responsibility.
Please accept my apologies for the late reply.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | I apologise for the mistake in the report. | My apologies, I sent you the wrong date. | Sorry for the delay. | I take full responsibility. | Please accept my apologies for the late reply.

card.headline: Which phrase will you use next time?

beats.speech: That's fifteen ways to say sorry. Which one will you use next time? Write it in the comments.
